title: Case Match Result Schema v0.1
description: Schema for Case RAG match results. Case matches provide reference patterns only and must not be used as standalone legal conclusions.

tax_case_id.description: Unique identifier of the current Tax Case.

case_match_results.description: Historical case pattern matches related to the current Tax Case.

case_match_result_id.description: Unique ID of this case match result, such as CaseMatch.001.

matched_case_id.description: Reference ID of the matched historical case.

matched_case_title.description: Title or short name of the matched case.

matched_case_source.description: Source of the matched case, such as tax authority, court, inspection case, or public typical case.

match_status.description: Current status of this case match.

match_score.description: Similarity score between the current Tax Case and the historical case pattern.

matched_pattern_type.description: Main pattern type represented by the matched case.

similar_facts.description: Facts in the current Tax Case that are similar to the historical case.

different_facts.description: Important differences between the current Tax Case and the historical case.

missing_facts_for_stronger_match.description: Facts or evidence needed before the match can be treated as stronger.

source_contract_chain_ids.description: Contract chains related to this case match.

source_transaction_fact_ids.description: Transaction Facts related to this case match.

source_evidence_state_ids.description: Evidence State records used to evaluate the case match.

reference_value.description: How this historical case helps the current analysis.

limitations.description: Limitations of using this case as a reference.
